sentences.en: What should we do apart from getting outraged and protesting?
sentences.zh: 除了感到义愤并抗议之外，我们还能做什么？

sentences.en: If you are not outraged, you are not paying attention.
sentences.zh: 如果你没有感到义愤，那说明你根本没有注意。

sentences.en: I was outraged at the way she was treated.
sentences.zh: 我对于她所受到的待遇感到非常愤怒。

senses.zh: 愤慨，愤怒；骇人听闻的事，暴行
使愤怒，激怒；践踏（准则、法律等）；凌辱，强奸
